projects.title: DogGO
projects.description:
• Orchestrated multi-stage deployments to distributed VMs using phased releases to ensure zero-downtime updates
• Extracted alert dispatching into a dedicated worker with per-channel retry tracking and terminal-state archival
• Engineered Discord alerting with session management, automatic 401 token refresh, DB persistence, and fallback re-auth
• Integrated OAuth 2.0 flows for Google, GitHub, and Discord using goth with session-backed account linking

projects.title: CivAI
projects.description:
• Created a civilization simulation game using Nvidia NemoAgents to act as other nation leaders
• Developed an orchestration agent to determine the outcome of events the user types, and broadcasts the outcome
• Achieved persistent long-term memory using MongoDB vector store and allowing agents to run vector search freely
• Displayed actions of the player and agents through a world map, automatically focusing in on the related countries
